korean-tts.scope: Publisher-reported exact parameter total for the pinned step-160000 FP32 ONNX graph, including waveform generator.

lfm3-audio-2b-gguf.scope: Sum the logical shapes of rank-two-or-higher blk.*.weight tensors in the language-model GGUF. This excludes token embeddings, the multimodal projector and the vocoder.

lfm3-omni-2b-gguf.scope: Sum the logical shapes of rank-two-or-higher blk.*.weight tensors in the language-model GGUF. This excludes token embeddings, the multimodal projector and the vocoder.

lfm3-audio-2b-fusor-q7-cpu.scope: Sum the logical shapes of rank-two-or-higher llm.layers.*.weight entries. This excludes the output head, codebooks and codec.

lfm3-omni-2b-fusor-q7-cpu.scope: Sum the logical shapes of rank-two-or-higher llm.layers.*.weight entries. This excludes the output head, codebooks and codec.

fun-cosyvoice3-0.5b-2512.scope: The official base llm.pt, flow.pt and hift.pt tensor directories contain 506,148,480, 332,257,120 and 20,779,887 distinct stored elements. The upper bound includes every buffer from those three synthesis components; the alternative RL checkpoint is excluded.

audio8-realistic-0.6b-int4.scope: The author counts 601,159,424 DualAR parameters. The registered decoder adds at most 130,380,129 initializer and 1,355 constant tensor elements. The benchmark uses reference-free generation and loads no codec encoder.

ming-3.0-tts-0.5b-gguf.scope: Sum rank-two-or-higher *.weight tensors under model (493,961,216), audio.decoder (361,046,784), flowloss (103,022,592) and linear_proj_audio (101,646,336). This excludes the audio and speaker encoders, speaker presets and quantization metadata.

ming-3.0-tts-0.5b-fusor-mix-cpu.scope: Sum rank-two-or-higher *.weight entries under llm, vae, flow and agg, plus llm.embed. Totals by component are 493,961,216, 361,046,784, 103,022,592 and 101,646,336. This counts the synthesis path and excludes quantization metadata and fixed buffers.

tiny-voca.scope: The model card reports the total trained model parameter count, including the waveform generator.

tiny-voca-de-en.scope: The pinned Voca64 model card reports the exact total trained parameter count, including the waveform generator.

tiny-swara.scope: The pinned model card reports the total synthesis parameter count, including its waveform generator.

tiny-voca-it.scope: Count of explicitly named FP32 .weight and .bias initializers in the pinned v0.3.0 FP32 ONNX graph. This is a scoped initializer lower bound; the scan does not prove which tensors are trainable. The graph contains 6,767,245 FP32 initializer values in total, including constants and buffers, so that total is not reported as a trainable parameter count.

zerre-tts.scope: Count of explicitly named FP32 weight and bias initializer values in the pinned int8 graph. Quantized matrix initializer values are not included in this count; it is a scoped lower bound, not the full model parameter total. The upstream card estimates approximately 4.5M parameters.

sopro-v2-turbo.scope: Hugging Face counts 121,574,193 FP32 entries in the main speech network. The four released safetensors files (core, semantic encoder, speaker encoder and vocoder) total 633,962,260 bytes, a conservative upper bound counting at least one byte per stored parameter. The two ONNX runtime profiles are alternate exports of the same model.

klein-tts-x1.5-pro.scope: The pinned official ONNX model metadata reports params=13,122,196 for the X1.5 Pro synthesis model.

silencio-2.scope: Exact sum of all parameters on the pinned BlueRoseLabs/Silencio-2 model before FP32 ONNX export; the count is computed from the loaded model, not inferred from checkpoint file size.

zonos3-mini.scope: Conservative lower bound sums all backbone .weight tensor shapes plus embd_all and codec .weight tensor shapes, excluding the 254-element head.mixer.weight and all codebook tables, biases, fixed windows and resampler. The 1,070,816,040 logical-element upper bound includes the manifest tensors, including known nonlearned window and resampler buffers. The optional speaker encoder is excluded from both counts.

sano-heart-nano-gguf-f32.scope: Exact total published for the selected heartnano synthesis stack: duration 22,858 + acoustic 65,299 + decoder 206,122 = 294,279. The Kokopop F32 GGUF expands the same pinned Q8 matrices without changing tensor count.

sano-robot-mcu.scope: Official robot MCU end-to-end neural frontend and decoder, distinct from the PiperLite Kristin voice.

sano-trellis.scope: Trellis-RIFT complete English text-to-wave pipeline, including duration/acoustic/decoder weights in the pinned bundle.

inflect-atom-v3.scope: All unique learned weights in the qualified AtomDSP core, including six voice embeddings, encoder/decoder shared weights, harmonic phases and FIR. Official export requires157190. English eSpeak-light frontend is rule/dictionary-based, zero learned frontend parameters.

sano-heart-gguf.scope: Exact source duration, acoustic and decoder synthesis-stack count. Conversion changes storage representation, not the declared trainable count.

sano-amy-gguf.scope: Exact source duration, acoustic and decoder synthesis-stack count. Conversion changes storage representation, not the declared trainable count.

sano-amy-small-gguf.scope: Exact source duration, acoustic and decoder synthesis-stack count. Conversion changes storage representation, not the declared trainable count.

sano-amy-1p8m-gguf.scope: Exact source duration, acoustic and decoder synthesis-stack count. Conversion changes storage representation, not the declared trainable count.

sano-hfc-gguf.scope: Exact source duration, acoustic and decoder synthesis-stack count. Conversion changes storage representation, not the declared trainable count.

sano-kristin-gguf.scope: Exact source duration, acoustic and decoder synthesis-stack count. Conversion changes storage representation, not the declared trainable count.

inflect-mini-v3-browser-port.scope: The pinned Mini v3 model card reports 34.31M core parameters (34,310,790). The browser profile uses the same learned checkpoint tensors converted to dynamic FP32 ONNX graphs; style conditioning and source-linear values are included in its download closure but do not change the registered upstream parameter count.

ua-serhiy-0p58m.scope: Exact sum of scalar values in the pinned inference-state manifest (duration, acoustic and decoder tensors). This stored-tensor count may include non-trainable buffers and is not asserted as a trainable-only count; it is far below the one-billion single-repetition threshold.

kale-tts-1-nano-int8.scope: Sum the logical shapes of ONNX graph initializers ending in .weight or .weight_q. This lower bound excludes biases, folded or renamed matrices, constants and voice inputs. The model card reports approximately 7.5 million parameters for the full Nano speech graph.

kale-tts-1-nano-fp32.scope: Sum the logical shapes of ONNX graph initializers ending in .weight or .weight_q. This lower bound excludes biases, folded or renamed matrices, constants and voice inputs. The model card reports approximately 7.5 million parameters for the full Nano speech graph.

vocina-it.scope: Count of explicitly named FP32 weight and bias initializers in the pinned Vocina INT8 graph. It is a scope-aware stored-initializer lower bound, not a verified trainable-parameter total. The graph scan finds 4,533,743 stored initializer values; upstream advertises approximately 4.5M.

clarvia-tts-tiny.scope: The pinned model card reports total trained parameters including the waveform generator.

tiny-voca-ja-tsukuyomi-chan.scope: Exact count of stored FP32 scalar values in the original waveform graph across 2,330 top-level nodes. The separate duration graph shares model.weights.bin and is not counted again.

tiny-voca-ja-v3.scope: Exact number of stored FP32 initializer scalar values in the original v3 waveform graph. The separate benchmark profile selects F2 (voice index 0); the graph bundles F2 and M2.

slyszeglosy-v1.scope: Publisher-reported parameter count for the pinned V1 model, including its waveform generator.

tiny-voca-ru.scope: The publisher reports exactly 4,534,411 parameters for the pinned Russian model, including its waveform generator.

tiny-voca-es.scope: The pinned Spanish model card reports 4,534,411 parameters for the released model, including its waveform generator.

alpa-es.scope: Exact sum of loaded model parameter tensor elements from the pinned alpa-es.pt checkpoint. The reproducible builder records the count in its export evidence.

tiny-voca-ptbr.scope: The pinned model card reports 4,533,259 parameters for the released Brazilian Portuguese model, including its waveform generator.

tiny-voca-ptbr-kokoro.scope: Author-reported exact parameter total for the pinned FP32 ONNX checkpoint, including the waveform generator.

tui-voice-mini-ml.scope: Publisher-reported exact count for the pinned Malayalam model; not independently recomputed from the checkpoint.

tiny-broca.scope: Publisher-reported exact parameter count for the pinned FP32 checkpoint, including its waveform generator.

tiny-voca-ar-halabi.scope: Publisher-reported exact parameter count for the pinned Arabic F2 FP32 checkpoint, including the waveform generator.

tiny-voca-ar.scope: The pinned publisher card reports 4,537,867 model parameters; use this only as the model-wide reported total, not a benchmark measurement.

tiny-voca-arabic.scope: Publisher-reported exact count for the selected FP32 speech checkpoint; CATT v2 diacritizer is a separately licensed frontend component, not included in the speech-model parameter count.

tiny-voca-he.scope: Exact parameter count for the pinned FP32 acoustic checkpoint; separate INT8 RenikudPlus G2P graph is a frontend dependency and excluded from this speech-model count.

bengali-voice.scope: Publisher-reported acoustic model parameter count only; the separately loaded trained G2P encoder and decoder are excluded, so this lower bound is not the total synthesis-path parameter count.

tiny-voca-hindi.scope: Exact count of the 205 tensor shapes parsed from the pinned GGUF v3 header; this is the checkpoint tensor element total, not a benchmark measurement.

tiny-urdu.scope: Exact sum of logical scalar values in all initializer tensor shapes in the pinned FP32 ONNX graph. It includes graph constants and is not asserted as a trainable-only count; the publisher rounds the model to 4.5 million parameters. This is far below the one-billion single-repetition threshold.

tiny-voca-swahili.scope: Sum of logical scalar values in the 184 FP32 ONNX initializers of the pinned graph, including constant tensors.

sobbie-tts.scope: Sum of logical scalar values in the 184 FP32 ONNX initializers of the pinned graph, including constant tensors.

alpa-sanskrit.scope: Sum of logical scalar values in the 184 FP32 ONNX initializers of the pinned graph, including constant tensors.

fiato.scope: Sum of logical scalar values in the 184 FP32 ONNX initializers of the pinned graph, including constant tensors.

tiny-voca-ptpt.scope: Publisher count for the complete European Portuguese F3 and M1 checkpoint, including waveform generation.

tiny-voca-lg.scope: Publisher-reported exact parameter count for the pinned step-4000 tiny-voca-lg FP32 ONNX configuration; count is not independently recomputed from tensor shapes.

browser-voice-gu-int6.scope: Publisher count for the acoustic checkpoint. The recurrent G2P encoder and decoder are loaded separately and excluded.

tiny-voca-sinhala.scope: Exact sum of logical scalar values in all 184 FP32 ONNX initializer shapes in the pinned step-55000 speech graph, including graph constants; the publisher rounds the checkpoint to 4.5 million parameters.
